clockwork archivist, post-collapse, rendered as vector flat concept art moodboard, a pastel low-contrast grade, brushed aluminium

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a Portra-style palette with creamy skin tones and soft greens. Lighting reference: north-facing window light with a black v-flat for negative fill.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
